_readme: Client registry for preflight.py / postflight.py (2026-09-03). One entry per pipeline skill.
engine: higgsfield-cli | higgsfield-mcp | flow.  account/workspace are what `higgsfield account status`
must print before the first fire; a mismatch is a FLAG (exit 2) - never fire on the wrong client's credits.
drive_root_id: the client's delivery root on the gdrive: rclone remote (reached by id, never by path).
models_allowed: what the skill doctrine permits; anything else is a FLAG until the user confirms.
brand_doc / packaging_ref: what the END-OF-GEN gate reads before calling a batch brand-compliant.

flow.account: <your Google account signed in to Flow>
flow.account_note: Not a client account. Verify the logged-in avatar in Edge and run SETTINGS-ASSERT before every prompt; the Flow project name must match the local project folder.
flow.models_note: Stills: Nano Banana 2 (free). Motion: Google Omni (12cr/8s) or Veo 3.1 Lite (5cr) per the user's call. Never buy credits.
flow.drive_root_note: Deliveries go where the brief says; pass --drive-folder-id, or skip Drive when the deliverable is handed over locally
flow.packaging_rule: No product packaging - the mascot / UGC person and the beat graphic are the brand surface. Numbers on screen must match the manifest exactly.
brand_rules: Every number spoken and shown matches the manifest `spoken` / `dialogue` fields
No captions, subtitles, logos or watermarks on generated frames
Identity holds against project.char_ref across every line
Brand / compliance check on the brand field before firing
